Project Report
Lantern Making Workshop 🪔
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund East
Date: 4th November 2026
Venue: Utkarsh Nutan Vidyalaya
Time: 10:00 AM onwards
Children:150 students

A creative and colourful Lantern Making Workshop was organised for the students of Utkarsh Nutan Vidyalaya as part of our Diwali celebrations.
The children enthusiastically participated in making beautiful, colourful lanterns, expressing their creativity and learning the joy of teamwork and sustainable celebrations.
A special thank you to Chitra Ma’am and Firdous for patiently guiding and teaching the children throughout the workshop.
Members Present:
Rtn Shaline Serpes
Rtn Shilpa
Rtn Ambika
The workshop was filled with creativity, learning and festive cheer, bringing smiles to the children's faces.
Let’s light up creativity and spread the joy of Diwali! 🪔✨
